'''2000 Origins Death Star II Pre-Release''' was a Star Wars CCG pre-release held in Origins, Columbus, Ohio on 16 July 2000. It is known from Josh Paterniti's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1021">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-18-orgins-2000d1021/ orgins-2000], DeckTech (Josh "Jizosh003" Paterniti, 18 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-18-orgins-2000d1021/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 Origins Open]].

* '''Date:''' 16 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Origins, Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
